status.description: reproduced: a check of the mechanism fails as the report says (a timeout alone is not one). partially-reproduced: part of it, said which in summary. not-reproduced: the steps and variations in tried all behaved. blocked: the browser host was unavailable, or an outside service the feature needs is offline; never counts as reproduced or ruled out.

summary.description: What the browser showed, for CD and the planner, in plain language: what failed and how, or what behaved. Posted on the issue.

reason.description: For blocked: what blocked it (the UNAVAILABLE line, the offline service). For not-reproduced: what would change the outcome, such as data or steps the issue lacks. Empty otherwise.

tried.description: The steps followed and each variation, one line each: the steps in the report first, then at most two variations.

failed_requests.description: Every request the page made that failed (requestfailed, or a response of 400 or more), method, URL and status or error, one each; outside hosts blocked by design included.

spec.description: The reproducing spec as written: its path in the repository (repro-<issue>-<slug>.spec.ts where the Playwright config of the project runs it) and its full content. Both empty when no spec was written (blocked before one could be).

ci_runs_spec.description: Whether the CI of the project runs a spec at that path: yes, no, or unknown.
